statement: Craft Biggie Hours summon item in Anvil tab 2 midway down; needs 2 Woodular Circles 5 Distilled Water 1 Capitalist Case.

creator: nocturne
statement: Woodular Circles are a rare drop from Sticks.

creator: nocturne
statement: Distilled Water comes from Alchemy or rare drops in World 3.

statement: Limited daily Capitalist Cases means limited chances to fight Biggie Hours.

creator: nocturne
statement: Bypass the summon requirement by fighting him in World 2 Colosseum where he spawns in Wave 15.

creator: nocturne
statement: Biggie Hours requires at least 300 Accuracy for a 5% hit chance.

creator: nocturne
statement: 900 Accuracy gives a 100% hit chance against Biggie Hours.

creator: nocturne
statement: 594 Defense needed to take no damage from Biggie Hours.

statement: Unlocking Maestro requires fighting Biggie Hours with 1 HP so you cannot take any damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: One way to avoid damage is gaining 594 Defense.

creator: nocturne
statement: Other way: when he runs across the map go down the rope ladder to avoid him then climb back up and keep fighting.

statement: You do not need to worry about the Mimics as they do no damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: Biggie Hours takes about a minute to kill with abilities.
